title.zh-CN: Dominion：多买一张免费牌，为什么还会有代价？
title.en: Dominion: why can one more free card still have a cost?

summary.zh-CN: 从一张银币与两轮开局推算，解释新牌何时可用、免费铜币怎样影响后续抽牌，以及牌库顺畅与最终得分的取舍。
summary.en: Track a Silver through two opening turns to understand when new cards become usable, how free Copper affects later draws, and why end scoring changes priorities.
